profile.description: Four resident input frames sharing weights; all outputs and canonical/working weight state checked.

timing_protocol.scope: whole four-frame sequence including timed resets, communication, all output and working-weight snapshots

research.hypothesis: Group four consecutive FP16 K terms per column. Keep only one implicit map input and load the other three scalar weights through the current group pointer, avoiding multi-input map DSR interference. Four independently advancing output descriptors preserve K order; source DSRs1/4/5/6 are free after the shift, concurrent two-hop transfers use2/3. Residency resets retain full per-frame invariant checks.
research.falsification: Reject missing/reordered terms, changed fixed timer/precision/PE controls, any six-case output/state/shutdown failure, or memory above1.10x. Retain only full fresh paired evidence at1.05x or better.
